in_hindi.long_meaning: One who is enchanted by the God of Fire or attracts through the power of the God of Fire

in_marathi.name: Mohitsh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे The one who attracts
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mohitsh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'mohana' which means 'to attract'. In Hindu mythology, Mohitsh is a name given to various gods and demigods who possess the power to attract or enchant.
